{{Quote|The way this battle is going, there won't be much left of this place to throw at them.|[[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Paradise Lost" />}}
'''Phorose''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==History==
[[File:Phorose_tunnels.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Phorose's underground tunnels.]]
Phorose was home to ancient temples and [[City/Legends|cities]] built long before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that conflict, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Battle of Phorose|battled]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], in an attempt to prevent the Confederacy from invading the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. Led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the Republic forces fought back the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] but left most of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city in ruin.

During the fighting, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Offee attempted to rescue a community of native [[Ru]], but was unable to prevent them from being killed in the fighting. Believing that the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were culpable for their [[Death/Legends|deaths]], it was this event that encouraged Offee's disenchantment with the Republic war effort and the Jedi's place in it.
